preconditions.description: The length of the permutations n is between 1 and 2000 inclusive.
Both input sequences p and s have exactly n elements.

preconditions.expression: set(p) == set(range(1, n + 1)) and set(s) == set(range(1, n + 1))
preconditions.description: Both p and s are valid permutations containing each number from 1 to n exactly once.

postconditions.expression: total_cost == sum(abs(int(line.split()[0]) - int(line.split()[1])) for line in operations_lines)
postconditions.description: The printed total cost equals the sum of absolute differences of indices for all printed swap operations.
The number of operation lines printed matches the integer k printed on the second line.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= n and 1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= n and int(line.split()[0]) != int(line.split()[1]) for line in operations_lines)
postconditions.description: Every operation line contains two distinct valid indices between 1 and n.
Applying the sequence of swaps to the initial permutation p results in the target permutation s.
The total cost printed is the minimum possible cost to transform p into s using the defined swap cost metric.
